subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Months and weeks are tools humans use to live together.”?
options: Sometimes they only need a different purpose.
Tools amplify habits, whether serious or careless.
It became a way to taste different homes.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Months and weeks are tools humans use to live together. Different tools shape different rhythms.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes they only need a different purpose.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Tools amplify habits, whether serious or careless.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It became a way to taste different homes.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Months and weeks are tools humans use to live together. Different tools shape different rhythms.」，答案為「Different tools shape different rhythms.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Different tools shape different rhythms.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
